user.title: Connect to Caavo Home
user.description: Enter the Caavo's private LAN IPv4 address and the API key shown in its on-TV Integration settings. The local HTTP API uses your trusted LAN; it does not encrypt traffic.

discovery_confirm.title: Connect to {name}
discovery_confirm.description: A Caavo was verified at {host}. Copy its API key from the on-TV Integration settings.

reauth_confirm.title: Update the Caavo API key
reauth_confirm.description: The unit at {host} rejected its saved API key. Enter the current key from its on-TV Integration settings.

reconfigure.title: Update the Caavo connection
reconfigure.description: The address must identify the same Caavo. Leave the API key blank to keep the saved key.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check the address, trusted-LAN access, and that Caavo Home's local API is running.
error.invalid_auth: The API key was rejected. Copy the current key from the Caavo's Integration settings.
error.invalid_host: Use a private or link-local IPv4 address, without a port, URL, or path.
error.identity_mismatch: This address identifies a different Caavo. Its API key was not sent. Check the address before continuing.
error.unsupported_api: This endpoint does not support Caavo Home API v1. Update the launcher or check its address.

abort.already_configured: This Caavo is already configured. A newly discovered address is updated only after its device identity matches.
abort.cannot_connect: The discovered Caavo could not be reached.
abort.invalid_host: This discovery did not contain a supported private IPv4 address.
abort.invalid_auth: The discovered endpoint did not allow identification without credentials.
abort.identity_mismatch: The discovered address did not match the advertised Caavo identity. No API key was sent.
abort.unsupported_api: The discovered service does not support Caavo Home API v1.
